blocks.title: Risk assessment aur management
blocks.text: Risk assessment aur management ka matlab un mumkina khatron ko pehchanna hai jo project ki kamyabi par asar dal sakte hain, un ke hone ke imkan aur asar ka tajziya karna, aur un se nimatne ki hikmat-e-amli banana. Acha risk management projects ko raah par, budget ke andar aur maiyar ke mutabiq rakhta hai.

items: Khatre pehchanein: har woh cheez list karein jo project par asar dal sakti hai, jaise technical khatre (technology ki tabdeeli), operational khatre (wasail ki kami) ya bairooni khatre (market ka utaar charhao).
Khatron ka tajziya: har khatre ka imkan aur asar jaanch kar tay karein ke kin par zyada tawajjo chahiye.
Kam karne ki hikmat-e-amli: har aham khatre ka imkan ya asar kam karne ka mansooba, maslan schedule mein gunjaish, mutabadil wasail ya zaid testing.
Nigrani aur jaaiza: naye khatron par nazar rakhein aur zaroorat par hikmat-e-amli badlein.

blocks.title: Misal
blocks.text: Ek project nayi, na-azmooda technology istemal karta hai, aur khatra yeh hai ke woh tawaqqo ke mutabiq kaam na kare, jis se der aur zaid kharcha ho. Kam karne ka tareeqa: technology ko poori tarah shamil karne se pehle chhota pilot project chala kar aazmayein, ta ke masail main project ko nuqsan pohanchaye baghair jaldi samne aa jayein.
Kitab ek Figure 1.8 ka hawala deti hai jo risk management ka yeh amal dikhaye, magar koi Figure 1.8 chhapi hui nahi.

blocks.prompt: Risk assessment aur management ke bare qadmon aur software project mein un ki ahmiyat ka jaaiza lijiye (short question 5).
blocks.explanation: Khatre pehchanne se koi aham baat nazar-andaz nahi hoti; imkan aur asar ka tajziya mehnat ko khatarnak khatron par markooz karta hai; kam karne ke mansoobe der aur zaid kharche ko hone se pehle kam karte hain; nigrani project badalne par naye khatre pakarti hai. Mil kar yeh project ko waqt par, budget ke andar aur matlooba maiyar par rakhte hain.

items: Risk management: pehchanna, tajziya (imkan aur asar), kam karna, nigrani aur jaaiza.
Misal: nayi technology ko pehle chhote pilot project se aazmana.
